name: Techno-Fascism
notAnIdeology: Techno-fascism redirects to a Wikipedia disambiguation page that lists unrelated meanings (techno-populism, techno-authoritarianism, Japanese 1930s reform-bureaucrat rule, and a 2024 analytical framework for tech-oligarchic domination) rather than an article on one set of beliefs; the term is mostly a critics' label for a method of governance, and the nearest covered ideologies are techno-populism, technocracy and fascism.
